summary: Add scripts/ci-local-gate, which runs the Linux gate's member jobs on one machine in the commands CI runs and writes the aggregate facts

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this adds a developer script, its test and documentation only.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. No skip policy changes and every check stays enforce false; nothing signs or skips because of this script yet.

compatibility.detail: No command, frame, scope or stored-format change in the product; the script is new and nothing calls it yet.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action is required. Running the script is optional and local.

recovery.detail: No persistent product state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
